To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“Data is a disruptive technology that has an influence on all phases within the TOGAF architecture development cycle and therefore, the architecture development cycle should be adapted to support data-driven enterprises”.
Data is a disruptive technology that can be used in the TOGAF framework to enable data-driven Enterprise Architectures.
Data and Big-Data are a disruptive technology that has the potential to transform enterprises into data-driven enterprises.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether the TOGAF framework should be adapted to accommodate Data and Big Data as disruptive forces.
the question: how can data-driven EA be supported by TOGAF?

the following research questions: How does the TOGAF architecture development process support data-driven enterprise architecture? What are the key activities in each ADM phase that support data-driven enterprise? How does the ADM support data-driven enterprise?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Data is a disruptive technology that has a significant impact on all the phases of the ADM. The impact is not only on the ADM, but also on EA
Data as a disruptive innovation is not only a new source of data but also a source of information that could enable the enterprise to be more data-driven.
the TOGAF 9.1 ADM is not sufficient in supporting the data-driven enterprise and that a data-driven enterprise architecture is needed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data-driven EA model can be used as an alternative approach to traditional EA.

Data and Data Science are disruptive technologies for the enterprise and that the TOGAF Architecture Development Method (ADM) needs to be adapted to incorporate data-driven enterprise architecture (DDEA) solutions.
Data and Big data are not only disruptive technologies but also a key component of data-driven EA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
data should be incorporated at every phase of the ADM and that data is not only a disruptive technology but also a disruptive force.
the TOGAF Architecture Repository should be expanded to accommodate Data and Big Data.
data should be considered as an important element within each phase of the TOGAAF ADM.
